name: publicWeb_getEvents
description: Returns upcoming or past runs for one kennel (by PublicKennelId), limited by count, an absolute date cutoff or a relative number of days. Upcoming = EventStartDatetimeGmt within the last 8 hours or later (a morning run stays visible that evening), ascending; past = EventStartDatetimeGmt before now, descending — so a run can be in both lists for up to 8 hours. Only visible, live runs (IsVisible = 1, deleted = 0, removed = 0) of a live kennel. Fee columns resolve the event-level override against the kennel's default fee. @SummaryOnly = 1 nulls the heavy text fields for list views. Two rowsets so an empty event list is not read as a 404. No authentication (anonymous PublicWebApi GET). Read-only.

parameters.name: PublicKennelId
parameters.description: Public kennel GUID as text; CONVERTed to UNIQUEIDENTIFIER (a malformed value raises a conversion error → CatchEnvelope). Unknown or inactive kennel → empty rowset 0 → shim 404. No SQL default.

parameters.name: IsFuture
parameters.description: 1 = upcoming (EventStartDatetimeGmt >= now − 8 h, ascending); 0 = past (EventStartDatetimeGmt < now, descending). No SQL default.

parameters.name: MaxEvents
parameters.description: Cap on the number of events returned. At least one of MaxEvents, DateCutoff, or DaysOffset must be supplied. May be combined with a date param (AND logic).

parameters.name: DateCutoff
parameters.description: Absolute far boundary, CONVERTed to DATETIMEOFFSET(7) (an ISO date with no offset is taken as UTC) and compared with EventStartDatetimeGmt. Mutually exclusive with DaysOffset.

parameters.name: DaysOffset
parameters.description: Relative boundary in days from now (always positive; direction from IsFuture). Mutually exclusive with DateCutoff.

parameters.name: SummaryOnly
parameters.description: When 1, EventDescription, EventUrl and w3wJson are returned as NULL (list views). Default 0.

rowsets.name: ValidationError
rowsets.description: Instead of the normal rowsets when a guard fails (PublicKennelId blank; none of MaxEvents / DateCutoff / DaysOffset; both DateCutoff and DaysOffset; MaxEvents <= 0; DaysOffset <= 0; lines 68-99). Not logged to HC.ErrorLog. The SP returns.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: Fixed text describing the bad input.

rowsets.name: CountHeader
rowsets.description: Exactly one row when the kennel is found; zero rows (SELECT TOP 0) when the kennel is unknown or inactive → shim returns 404. Counts every matching run before the MaxEvents cap.

columns.name: TotalMatchingEvents
columns.description: Total events matching the filter before the MaxEvents cap is applied.

rowsets.name: Events
rowsets.description: One row per matching run, at most @MaxEvents, ORDER BY EventStartDatetimeGmt ASC (upcoming) or DESC (past). Empty when nothing matches.

rowsets.name: CatchEnvelope
rowsets.description: On a runtime error (CATCH, line 358): { Success = 0, ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE() }, possibly after rowsets already sent. NOT logged to HC.ErrorLog and not re-raised.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: ERROR_MESSAGE().

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: The CATCH (lines 356-359) returns { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } without writing HC.ErrorLog and without THROW, so a timeout or bad input surfaces to the shim as a data rowset and leaves no server-side record (CLAUDE.md 'Every CATCH must log').

@PublicKennelId and @IsFuture have no SQL default (lines 2-3). A caller that omits one is refused by SQL Server before the procedure runs — an empty 500 with no HC.ErrorLog row (CLAUDE.md 'SP parameter with NO default'). The Next.js client always sends them, so this is latent.

@PublicKennelId is NVARCHAR(50) and CONVERTed at line 107; a malformed id is a conversion error caught as a generic failure instead of a validation message. UNIQUEIDENTIFIER would let the shim reject it.

Lines 216-226 / 294-304 COALESCE EventStartDatetimeGmt with an AT TIME ZONE computation for NULLs, but the column is NOT NULL and the WHERE already requires it — the fallback (and the timezone lookup feeding it) never fires.

feeResolutionLogic.description: Fee fields follow a two-level fallback. The event record stores a per-event fee override; NULL means 'use the kennel default'. The SP resolves this at query time so callers always receive the effective fee.
precedence: 1. Event.EventPriceForMembers / EventPriceForNonMembers / EventCurrencyType — per-event override, set only when the event charges a different fee from the kennel default
2. Kennel.DefaultEventPriceForMembers / DefaultEventPriceForNonMembers / DefaultEventCurrencyType — kennel-wide default; applied when event fields are NULL
notes: EventPriceForMembers and EventPriceForNonMembers are never NULL in the result — kennel defaults (DECIMAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0) guarantee a value
EventCurrencyType may still be NULL if neither the event nor the kennel has a currency configured
0 means free — callers should display 'Free' rather than '0.00'

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never make EventPriceForMembers or EventPriceForNonMembers nullable in the result — callers depend on non-null values after the kennel default fallback
